newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS -UK bank stock options heavily traded.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -UK bank stock options heavily traded.

text.p: Traded option in the UK banking sector were in demand on Tuesday as traders positioned themselves ahead of the banks reporting season starting next month, dealers said.
The main trades were long positions in Lloyds TSB, Abbey National and Barclays.

In Lloyds TSB a long straddle was established through buying 1,000 June 460 puts and calls at 25p and 36p respectively. A profit will be made at expiry if the underlying stock either goes below 399p or above 521p.
By 1320 GMT, Lloyds TSB shares had fallen 8-1/2p to 448p.

A long strangle in Abbey National consisted of the purchase of 500 April 750 puts at 33p along with 500 April 800 calls at 18p. For a profit, this deal also requires the underlying shares to move sufficiently in either direction before expiry.
The main deal in Barclays was a calendar spread consisting of selling 500 April 1000 puts at 50p and buying 500 July 1000 puts at 59p.
The deal requires Barclays' shares to be at 10 stg by April expiry -- when the April put will be worthless -- and then for the shares to rise between the April-July expiry dates.

Elsewhere, railway infrastructure operator Railtrack was also wanted for a calendar spread with the sale of 1,000 June 390 calls at 32p and the purchase of 1,000 September 390 calls at 41p. The partly paid shares dipped 4p to 385-1/2p.
And over in supermarket chain Asda Group a short strangle was established by selling 3,000 April 120 puts at 3p and 3,000 April 130 calls at 4-1/2p.
